$comment: Ovrly contracts 0.3.0-draft (pre-1.0). Mirrors backend/services/api/schemas.py Evidence and EvidenceSource.
title: Evidence
description: One retrieved source considered for one claim. Evidence records identity (source), kind (source_type), how much of it was actually read (inspection_level), how relevant retrieval judged it (retrieval_relevance) and whether the source itself has since been corrected, retracted or withdrawn (retraction_status). It deliberately carries no support relation: whether it supports, challenges or qualifies the claim lives in the assessment, so relevance and support can never be confused.

claim_id.description: The claim this evidence was retrieved for; refers to a claim in the same report version.

excerpt.description: Short quoted passage the assessment relied on, or null when only metadata was inspected.

retrieved_at.description: When the source was fetched; shown as the retrieval date in exports.

source.description: Identity of the source independent of this claim.

id.description: Stable identifier of the source document, so the same source cited for two claims is recognisably one source.

url.description: Where the source was retrieved from, or null for sources without a public location.
